title: Research: exact S3 two-target no-sharing census
body:
## Result

This package gives an exact two-register bound in a finite nonabelian address model. For every ordered pair `g,h` in `S3`, the formal dirty-register target `diag([g],[h])` over `F2[S3]` has minimum paid-call cost equal to the sum of the shortest `x,y` transposition word lengths, where `x=(12)` and `y=(23)`. Rank-one scalar mixing does not share a paid call between these two targets in this model.

The direct costs range from zero to six. The exact radius-five ball over the twelve generators `I+([s]+[1])N` has layers `[1,12,80,466,2345,10760]` and 13,664 distinct products. Radius five covers every possible saving because the largest direct bill is six. The 36 exact minima equal the direct bills; the maximum-cost pair `(xyx,xyx)` is absent through length five and has its six-call direct word.

## Scope and pins

- Track `bit-mechanisms`; task `bit-new-register-model`; accepted seed `36501a8544a63b2f0ecd2e6452836c79`; refined scope key `7084092dd726e7ba1f2f/S3-transposition-two-target-census/r2/all-36/radius-five`.
- Exact base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`.
- Selected record SHA-256: `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`; task catalogue SHA-256: `6686ad58f1fbdbc87134a78901b60fd53a20d3984355e91defbbebc9e9fa8075`.
- `SOURCES.json` pins the selected review, source manifest, assembly certificate, `autoresearch.md`, catalogue, selected record and the D8 predecessor README. No predecessor code is imported.

The exact changed hypothesis is the address group: this uses finite nonabelian `S3` instead of the selected construction's rational additive address group. It has no physical supplier map and makes no selected-profile or `kappa` claim. The selected source-bound baseline still reports the complex primitive binding.

## Reproduction and evidence

From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/bit-s3-two-target-census-seed36501/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-s3-two-target-census-seed36501 --check-only
```

Expected verifier result: `PASS_S3_TWO_TARGET_NO_SHARING`, 13,664 radius-five products and all 36 minima equal to their direct bills. The verifier checks all 1,885 ordered words through length three against literal formal multiplication, replays every canonical path in the radius-five ball, checks all 36 direct words, and rejects 108 single-factor omissions.

Local normal and optimized replays pass on Python 3.14.7. Metadata and source pins pass. Python 3.12 is unavailable locally, so the registered package replay could not be run here; CI can run the declared Python 3.12 hook.

## Overlap and credit

Final pre-submission overlap refresh at 12:33:47 UTC covered 527 completely paginated open PRs and 506 Discussion records, with no exact S3 two-target census match. Nearby work uses different objects: PR #1822 uses Q8 central-commutator pairs; PR #1716 uses an AGL2 target triple; current D8, UT4 and D16 scopes use different groups or target words. No exact S3 transposition two-target census was found in the complete PR/Discussion snapshots.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. No new `kappa` is claimed.
